title: Attack 2: when a T12 island hydrates, the server's matrix and relation scroll boxes are replaced, so a keyboard reader whose focus is on one of them is thrown to <body> (M8 b4's first tab stop)
location: site/src/components/tools/T12RepresentationBuilder.svelte:456-474 (goLive) and :488-514 (activate), which replace the server markup of the relations, matrices and string panels; site/src/components/math/MatrixView.svelte:283-288 and :294 (adopt moves only the <table> into a new .box; the server's .box tab stop is discarded)
claim: Before hydration, the server markup of T12 holds scroll boxes (tabindex=0, role=group) for E, F, H and the two sides of the relation. They are the tool's only enabled tab stops, because the selects are disabled until hydration. After hydration, activate swaps those panels for live ones and the focused box is removed. On M8 every island after b1 is client:visible, so tabbing onto such a box is what makes the island hydrate, and the focus is then lost.
expected: 7.5 A-1 'Every tool is fully operable from the keyboard' and WCAG 2.4.3: the focus stays on the box the reader is on, or on its live replacement, as for every other control since the P3-RT-05-09 and P4-RT-05-01 fixes.
observed: M8 b4 (preset relation-checker): with the focus on the server box 'Left side', which is one Tab from the prose before b4, document.activeElement becomes BODY once data-hydrated=true and data-drawn=true. The same happens on b3 with the box E1. The focus survives on the orbit box and the signed box, whose panels are not swapped. 6/6 runs fail at load averages 2 to 24.
reproduction: From a clean checkout of 006f50d plus the reproducer: npm ci; npm run build; then npx playwright test redteam-RT-05-p5-t12-focus-at-hydration (here with the scratch config on port 5350 and PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH set). The test focuses the box without scrolling, then scrolls it into view, which is what a Tab does, in two steps so that hydration cannot start first. Result: 'Expected: div in b4 (relation-left), Received: BODY', and the same for b3 matrix-e.
specRef: SPEC.md 7.5 A-1 and A-2 (target WCAG 2.2 AA, 2.4.3 Focus Order); 4.0 'Keyboard and screen reader'; the precedents P3-RT-05-09 and P4-RT-05-01
proposedFix: Adopt the server's scroll box itself instead of only its table: let MatrixView take over the adopt root's .box, keep its focus and update its caption id. Alternatively, in goLive, record the focused element's data-out inside the replaced panel and focus the matching live box after the swap.
